resources:
  - name: instance-template
    type: compute.v1.instanceTemplate
    properties:
      properties:
        machineType: n1-standard-1
        disks:
        - deviceName: boot
          type: PERSISTENT
          boot: true
          initializeParams:
            diskSizeGb: 30
            sourceImage: projects/debian-cloud/global/images/debian-11-bullseye-v20220719
        networkInterfaces:
        - accessConfigs:
          - name: External NAT
            type: ONE_TO_ONE_NAT
          network: $(ref.network.selfLink)
        metadata:
          startup-script: |
            #! /bin/bash
            apt update
            apt install -y nginx
            systemctl start nginx
        tags:
          items:
          - http-server
          - https-server
  - name: instance-group-manager
    type: compute.v1.instanceGroupManager
    properties:
      zone: us-central1-a
      instanceTemplate: $(ref.instance-template.selfLink)
      targetSize: 1
      autoHealingPolicies:
      - initialDelaySec: 300

        type: PROACTIVE
        minimalAction: RESTART
        maxSurge:
          fixed: 1
        maxUnavailable:
          percent: 50
  - name: autoscaler
    type: compute.v1.autoscaler
    properties:
      zone: us-central1-a
      target: $(ref.instance-group-manager.selfLink)
      autoscalingPolicy:
        minReplicas: 1
        maxReplicas: 5
        coolDownPeriodSec: 60
        cpuUtilization:
          utilizationTarget: 0.6
